data.one_liner: Official StorifyMe SDK for adding stories and interactive widgets to Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: The StorifyMe Flutter SDK allows developers to add stories to their Flutter apps using the official StorifyMe GmbH services. It provides customizable story widgets like StoriesViewWidget along with methods to manage viewed states, customer IDs, and user segments.
use_when: You need to integrate StorifyMe stories into your Flutter application
You want to display story widgets with horizontal scrolling and view count tracking
avoid_when: You are building a custom story viewing experience without using the StorifyMe backend service
strengths: Official SDK provided by StorifyMe GmbH
Supports view count tracking, segment filtering, and custom customer ID configuration
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS
weaknesses: Limited documentation in the package README requiring reliance on external documentation
Tied directly to the proprietary StorifyMe service ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Follow the official documentation at docs.storifyme.com for setup details.
